probes.check: am_probe_imgui_math(): ImVec2 and ImVec4 sample values (thirds, tiny and huge magnitudes, negative zero) convert to glm::vec2 and glm::vec4 and back bit for bit.

seeded_violation.description: Convert an ImVec4 to glm::vec4 with w set to 1, as if every ImVec4 were an opaque color.

adaptation_notes: The adapters are inline functions in am::math, to_glm and to_imgui, compiled only when GLM is in the composition (AUTOMAP_LIBRARY_GLM); without a math library the round-trip rule is not-applicable.

ImGui's vectors are screen pixels, origin top left, y down; the adapters copy components and leave the convention to the caller. A game that prefers implicit conversions defines IM_VEC2_CLASS_EXTRA and IM_VEC4_CLASS_EXTRA in its ImGui config to call these, which no probe checks.
Dear ImGui exposes no world positions, so it states no position_precision.
